module: Flowgraph node 'Direction' (simple category). Converts an angle 'deg' in degrees into a rotation quaternion around the Z axis (setFromEuler(0,0,angle)). The result is recomputed only when the angle changes.
notes: The quaternion 'rot' is a module-local variable shared by all instances of the node, whereas the oldIn cache is per instance: two nodes with different angles may overwrite each other.
If the input angle is nil, work raises an arithmetic error on nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Recomputes the quaternion (module-local variable) if the angle changed, writes the quaternion table to 'value'.
